messages:
deploybot: [DEPLOYBOT] Canary alert for embed-service in eu-central: error rate 14%, tail latency +180ms, health checks failed on 3/8 canary pods. Rollout automatically paused. Requesting expedited ops decision: pin to previous image or abort rollout.

liz: On it. Is this impacting paid customers or only internal tests? :eyes: 

rahul: Looks like some customer traffic experienced degraded embeddings. Trace links show failure in quantized kernel path introduced in v1.2.7.

samira: We should pin to redwood/embed:v1.2.6-stable and scale down the canary. If ops can supervise, do the pin now.

ops_oncall: I can do the pin and watch metrics for 20m. If we still see >5% errors, we'll rollback to v1.2.5 and open incident channel.

liz: I'll prepare a short release-note entry and mark this as expedited. Need someone to run the pin command.

rahul: Executing:
```
/releasebot pin --service embed-service --to-image redwood/embed:v1.2.6-stable --owner rahul --reason "canary regressions v1.2.7" --priority expedited
```

releasebot: Pin command acknowledged. Validating image signature and policy... OK. Applying pin and rebalancing traffic. ETA ~35s.

deploybot: Traffic reroute complete. All user traffic now on redwood/embed:v1.2.6-stable. Canary v1.2.7 scaled to zero.

samira: Thanks. Drafted internal note: "Pin v1.2.6 due to canary regressions in v1.2.7 (quant kernel). Investigations assigned to rahul." Link: https://redwood.internal/releases/notes/1739999991

ops_oncall: Monitoring: error rate back to baseline (~0.6%), latency normalized. Will hold watch for 20m. Flagging for postmortem if root cause confirmed.

liz: +1 resolved for now. Please ping if metrics breathe up. Logging this as expedited pin per SLO policy. :white_check_mark: 

rahul: Added tasks: check kernel flags and ci-compare for quant builds. Also will run a staged reproduce on a test cluster.

ops_oncall: Stable at +25m. No further anomalies. Closing expedited window and marking thread resolved.
